messages.subject: knmodels with LCAR prior
parts:
Hi all, 

I was studying the knmodels() function, and wonder if it can accomodate LCAR prior for spatial random effect, instead of 'bym2'?  My intention is to include an unstructured spatial random effect in the model. Since LCAR has both structured and unstructured effects, I thought it may be appropriate. So I had a go with editing the example given as: 

res <- inla.knmodels(y ~ f(time, model='rw1') + # model = 'rw1', 'rw2', 'ar1',  
                       f(space, model='generic1', Matrix = Q.Leroux, constr =. TRUE),
                     data=dat, family='poisson', E=dat$e, progress=TRUE,
                     control.st=list(time=time, space=space,
                                     spacetime=spacetime, graph=graph, type=4), #c(1, 2, 3, 4)
                     control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, waic=TRUE, cpo=TRUE))

I am not sure with this, if the appropriate constraints can be established. 
Many thanks for clarifications. 
Aminath

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] knmodels with LCAR prior
parts:
Currently, it will add the constraints (as if the main effect has rank deficiency). I've updated the code so will (try to) check before adding it (it will be in the next testing version).
If you want to do it yourself you can use something like

y ~ f(time, model = 'rw1') +
  f(space, model = 'besagproper2', graph = "graph.file") + ## I prefer "besagproper" instead (has interpretability)
  f(spacetime, model = 'generic0',
    Cmatrix = kronecker(R.t, R.s),
    extraconstr = list(A = constr.t, e = rep(0, n.s))

P.S: I've some (old) code at http://www.leg.ufpr.br/~elias/cursos/br2015/ (check r/cwb-example.R) for models including the Knorr-Held ones.

best regards,
Elias
